answer: I looked at both our screens at the same time, and we hovered over the one we were each going to choose. If one person hovered over the opposite one, one of us would move to the same one so that we had the same answer. Before clicking we made sure we were over the same answer, and noticed patterns of which colors we preferred to speed up the process.

For this one I used the already establish pink priority, yellow last. then at the beginning before I'd click on my answer I made sure we were hovering over the same color. I think she did this too. At the end our brains were getting tired so we sometimes had to remind eachother. The final established order was pink, brown, purple, dark blue, light blue, orange, yellow. I used this communicatio period to work out where the blues and brown and purple went.
